result.summary: The image shows a wide commercial intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and overhead traffic signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment lacks pedestrian-specific protections such as refuge islands or visible pedestrian signals, and the wide roadway suggests a high-speed vehicle environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicles
hazards.description: The school bus and other vehicles near the intersection can block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for crossing.
